lines.en: A sitting animatronic does not walk.
Dust has settled on my knees.
Dust has gathered on my knees.
Someone tried to move me and could not lift.

lines.zh: 我这个位置是特意摆的。
lines.en: This position was arranged on purpose.
The chair and I are fixed together.
I sit. I can only watch.

lines.zh: 他们把我放在餐厅门口。
lines.en: They placed me at the diner's entrance.
I lean crooked and no one straightens me.
The floor has loosened under my feet.
I do not move, and I cannot.

lines.zh: 这具身体只有一半是实的。
lines.en: Only half this body is solid.
I sit with my hands on my knees.
My head faces the doorway.

lines.zh: 有人从我面前走过两次。
lines.en: Someone passed me twice.
The lights died; I'm still seated.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手里攥着东西。
lines.en: My other hand holds something.

lines.zh: 这只玩偶的眼睛不会动。
lines.en: This suit's eyes cannot move.
The wind outside rattles the door.
Nobody touches up my paint.
My feet do not touch the floor.
The chair creaked and I did not move.
A child stopped in front of me.

lines.zh: 我听见收银机开了又关。
lines.en: I heard the register open and shut.

lines.zh: 我的手指在椅面上敲了一下。
lines.en: One knuckle tapped the chair seat.

lines.zh: 墙上那排画已经褪色了。
lines.en: The row of drawings on the wall has faded.

lines.zh: 你看我坐着，就别站我面前。
lines.en: You see me sitting. Do not stand in front of me.

lines.zh: 这个姿势不是给人看的。
lines.en: This pose is not for anyone to see.
My glass eyes follow you.

lines.zh: 我低着头的角度，正好看见你。
lines.en: My lowered head has you in view.

lines.zh: 你听见椅子的声音了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the chair?
If you want to sit, there is no room.
Sitting makes me worse than standing.
Do not touch my knees.
You have been looking a long while.
Half this face is smiling.

lines.zh: 你离门太远了，你知道吗。
lines.en: You are far from the door. Do you know that?

lines.zh: 我坐着，你站着，这样不公平。
lines.en: I sit, you stand. That is unfair.

lines.zh: 你身后那面墙，没有开窗。
lines.en: The wall behind you has no window.

lines.zh: 我的头低着，可我在看你。
lines.en: My head is low, and I am watching you.

lines.zh: 你刚才听见椅子响了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the chair a moment ago?
I have waited a long time in this spot.
Your lamp is on me. Too bright.
Think it through before you turn.
My head has been knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 椅子腿断了一条，我斜着。
lines.en: A chair leg broke and I sit askew.
My arm fell to the floor.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我连头都懒得转。
lines.en: Not worth turning my head for.

lines.zh: 椅子和我一起晃了一下。
lines.en: The chair and I rocked together.
A hole has opened in my suit.
There is nothing inside. It barely hurts.
I settle back. The pose is unchanged.

lines.zh: 我记住这一下是谁打的。
lines.en: I know who struck that.
I sit and cannot do much about it.
I cannot eat, and no voice was installed.
Put it in my hand.

lines.zh: 我坐在这儿，什么也尝不到。
lines.en: Sitting here, I taste nothing.
That smell settles on my knees.

lines.zh: 盘子放在我旁边的桌上。
lines.en: The plate goes on the table beside me.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个托盘很久了。
lines.en: I have watched that tray a long while.
Flies are circling me.
That smell is wrong. It has turned.
I cannot even turn my head.
Just leave it there.
You kicked the chair leg.
I am sitting. I cannot be tipped.
I'm sitting here; don't step on my foot.

lines.zh: 你撞一下，椅子挪了半寸。
lines.en: That moved the chair half an inch.
From this place I do not move aside.
You are on my knee.
Not worth lifting my head for.

lines.zh: 绕开吧，这儿只容一个人。
lines.en: Go around. Only one fits here.
The chair back knocked the wall.
I sit, posture unchanged.
A sitting animatronic makes no pair.

lines.zh: 另一把椅子上也有一个。
lines.en: There is another one on another chair.
A corridor runs between us.
It has lost less paint than I have.
Neither of us looks at the other.

lines.zh: 夜里整层只有我们两个。
lines.en: At night the two of us have the floor.

lines.zh: 谁给我们摆的姿势，我们不知道。
lines.en: Neither of us knows who posed us.

lines.zh: 我们就这样坐着，很多年了。
lines.en: So we sit, for many years.

lines.zh: 有人把我们中的一个搬走了。
lines.en: Someone carried one of us away.
After that this side was empty.

lines.zh: 有人把糖纸丢在我脚边。
lines.en: Someone dropped a candy wrapper at my foot.

lines.zh: 一只手落在我膝上，我拿不了。
lines.en: A glove landed on my knee. I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我攥着的东西，不是我放的。
lines.en: What I hold was not placed by me.

lines.zh: 地上有枚硬币滚到椅下。
lines.en: A coin rolled under my chair.

lines.zh: 这顶帽子挂在我的肩上。
lines.en: This hat hangs on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的膝上放着一个纸杯。
lines.en: A paper cup sits on my knee.
A ticket stub dropped here.

lines.zh: 孩子们的玩具堆在我旁边。
lines.en: The children's toys are piled beside me.

lines.zh: 我坐在这儿，成了放东西的地方。
lines.en: Sitting here, I have become a shelf.

lines.zh: 这些东西，我一件也拿不起来。
lines.en: Not one of these can I lift.
That one stopped in the doorway.
He glanced this way.
I can see his legs.
He is two blocks from me.
He thinks I am only furniture.
He shines the lamp on my face.
He turns to look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的手在膝盖上收紧了。
lines.en: My hand tightens on my knee.

lines.zh: 黑下来时，我的姿势换了。
lines.en: When the lights die, my pose has changed.
He walks toward me.
He is alone and his steps are soft.

lines.zh: 我的位置挡住了唯一的出口。
lines.en: My place blocks the only exit.
He goes around me, past my side.
For that moment he was very close.
I lifted my head a little.
He stopped, as if listening.
He turned a full circle on the spot.
The lamp in his hand sways.

lines.zh: 我坐着，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: I sit without making a sound.
His back is to me while he reads the wall.
He took a step back. Very close.

lines.zh: 舞台的幕布后，我坐着不动。
lines.en: Behind the stage curtain, I sit still.

lines.zh: 他的肩膀碰到我的膝盖。
lines.en: His shoulder touched my knee.
His whole body went stiff.
I did not stand up.
He turned the lamp on me.
Now he cannot back away.

lines.zh: 椅子和墙把他夹在中间。
lines.en: The chair and the wall have him caught between.
He is breathing loud.
My hand is still on his shoulder.
He held that breath in.
I am waiting for him to understand.

lines.zh: 他往后一靠，靠到了我腿上。
lines.en: He leaned back against my legs.
Half of this body still moves.
I am sitting and my hand still reached him.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的衣领往回拽。
lines.en: I catch his collar and haul him back.

lines.zh: 椅子翻倒，我也跟着压下去。
lines.en: The chair tips and I come down with it.

lines.zh: 我的手指掐进他的手臂。
lines.en: My fingers bite into his arm.
This time I hit him from the side.
He pulls me up and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖顶到了他的背。
lines.en: My knee strikes his back.
He screamed. It was short.
I gather his head against me.

lines.zh: 弹簧在我胸口响了一声。
lines.en: A spring knocked inside my chest.

lines.zh: 他挣扎着，椅子在地上磨。
lines.en: He thrashes and the chair grinds on the floor.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手慢慢抬起来了。
lines.en: My other hand rises slowly.

lines.zh: 他的腿踢翻了旁边的桌子。
lines.en: His legs knock over the nearby table.
I press my whole body down.
He has stopped moving, and I have not let go.

lines.zh: 我慢慢坐回去，姿势不变。
lines.en: I settle back into the pose, unchanged.
They posed me at the entrance.

lines.zh: 我被放在一把旧椅子上。
lines.en: I was set on an old chair.
My knees point down the corridor.
The lamps went out and I stayed put.

lines.zh: 有人给我摆了个欢迎的手势。
lines.en: Someone arranged my hands in welcome.

lines.zh: 这一层的灯只亮了一半。
lines.en: Only half the lamps on this floor are lit.

lines.zh: 我对面是那面画满孩子的墙。
lines.en: Across from me is the wall of children's drawings.

lines.zh: 我的位置，看得到两个门。
lines.en: From here I can see both doors.

lines.zh: 坐下的时候，椅子响了一声。
lines.en: The chair creaked as I was set down.
They stepped away to look at something else.
I am here and any movement will squeak.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛正对着进来的路。
lines.en: My eyes face the way in.

lines.zh: 我被摆好，两手放在膝上。
lines.en: I am arranged with both hands on my knees.

lines.zh: 有人把椅子挪到了门边。
lines.en: Someone dragged the chair beside the door.

lines.zh: 这一晚的灯只开了两盏。
lines.en: Only two lamps are lit tonight.

lines.zh: 我落座的时候，弹簧响了一声。
lines.en: A spring rang as I was seated.
Under the carpet is bare floor.

lines.zh: 我的脸朝着进来的每一个人。
lines.en: My face turns to everyone who enters.

lines.zh: 绒毛烧起来了，气味很怪。
lines.en: My fur caught and the smell is wrong.
The chair went over and I hit the floor.

lines.zh: 水漫到我的膝上，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water reached my knees and I sank.

lines.zh: 爆响把椅子掀翻，我也翻了。
lines.en: The blast flipped the chair and me with it.
Something is lodged in my face.

lines.zh: 怪光让我的手指自己动了。
lines.en: Strange light moved my fingers on their own.

lines.zh: 我坐得太久，关节都硬了。
lines.en: Sitting so long, my joints have set.

lines.zh: 坐着不动，雷也劈不醒我。
lines.en: Sitting still, even lightning won't wake me.

lines.zh: 地板没了，椅子和我一起掉。
lines.en: The floor vanished and the chair went with me.
